name: org-memory
description: Structured knowledge base and task management using org-mode files and the org CLI.

orgBin.description: Path to the org CLI binary

inboxFile.description: Filename for new tasks (relative to humanDir)

agentDir.label: Agent Workspace Directory
agentDir.help: Where the agent keeps its own org files (memory.org, daily notes, tasks).

agentRoamDir.label: Agent Roam Directory
agentRoamDir.help: Where the agent's knowledge-graph nodes live. Defaults to <agentDir>/roam.

humanDir.label: Human Workspace Directory
humanDir.help: Your org workspace — tasks, projects, and inbox.org.

agentDb.label: Agent Database
agentDb.help: SQLite database for the agent's roam + index. Defaults to <agentDir>/.org.db.

humanDb.label: Human Database
humanDb.help: SQLite database for your roam + index. Defaults to <humanDir>/.org.db.

orgBin.label: org CLI Binary
orgBin.help: Path to the `org` binary. Must be on PATH or set to an absolute path.

inboxFile.label: Inbox File
inboxFile.help: Filename new TODOs are added to, relative to the workspace directory.
